info.title: Disgram API
info.description: API documentation for Disgram - a Telegram to Discord messages forwarding bot. This API provides administrative controls, log viewing capabilities, and system health checks.

tags.name: General
tags.description: Core application health and status information.

tags.name: Logs
tags.description: Endpoints to view, clear, or purge application logs.

tags.name: Git Persistence
tags.description: Manage GitHub commit attribution and persistence synchronization.

bearerAuth.description: Authorization token for administrative endpoints. Default value from `.env.example` is `secret_admin_token`. All POST requests require this token in the Authorization header.

get.description: Returns basic information about the Disgram application, a list of available REST endpoints, the number of configured channels, and overall health status.

example.name: Disgram
example.description: Telegram to Discord messages forwarding bot

get.description: Provides detailed health status of the application including external services (Telegram, Discord), worker status, system memory usage, log freshness, and Git configuration. Returns a 503 status code if essential services (like Telegram connectivity, Discord webhook accessibility, or log freshness) are failing.

503.description: Application is unhealthy (e.g. external connectivity failure or stale logs).

get.description: Serves the OpenAPI JSON specification file describing all available endpoints, required authentication, and response schemas.

500.description: Internal server error reading the file.

get.description: Returns the last 1000 lines of the `Disgram.log` file in plain text format. The log file tracks the sync progress between Telegram channels and Discord.

text/plain.example:
Disgram Log Viewer
Total lines in log: 500
Showing last 500 lines
Log file: /path/to/Disgram.log
Last modified: 2023-11-20T10:00:00.000Z
================================================================================

[INFO] Bot started successfully...

404.description: The `Disgram.log` file was not found on disk.

500.description: Internal server error occurred while reading the log file.

post.description: Soft clears the contents of `Disgram.log` while explicitly preserving the latest message tracking links and any warnings/errors that were previously logged. Requires Bearer authentication.

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid Bearer Token.

500.description: Internal server error (e.g., DisgramLogHandler not initialized).

post.description: Hard clears `Disgram.log`, aggressively dropping all warnings, errors, and text output, preserving ONLY the latest message link markers required to resume synchronization. Use this to shrink overgrown log files. Requires Bearer authentication.

example.message: Disgram.log purged successfully (only message markers preserved)

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid Bearer Token.

post.description: Forces an immediate git commit and push of all local changes (specifically log file updates) to the remote GitHub repository. Bypasses standard commit intervals. Requires Bearer authentication.

example.message: All changes committed to repository successfully

400.description: Git manager is not configured or disabled.

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid Bearer Token.

500.description: Failed to commit or push changes.

get.description: Debug endpoint to check the current Git manager synchronization status, GitHub token availability, commit intervals, and the timestamp of the last successful automated commit.

200.description: Returns the Git status or unconfigured state.
